name: com.trustguruglobal/calculators
title: TrustGuru Calculators
description: Calculate theoretical return, loss, and wagering turnover from caller-supplied inputs.

tools.name: calculate_rtp
tools.description: Compute total wagered, theoretical average return and loss at a constant stake. Use a supplied RTP for the exact game configuration; this tool does not look up RTP or predict outcomes.

bet.description: Positive stake per spin as decimal text, in one currency or accounting unit.

spins.description: Positive whole number of spins as a string.

rtp.description: RTP of the exact configuration as percent text, e.g. "96" for 96%, not "0.96".

tools.name: calculate_rollover
tools.description: Compute required wagering credit and turnover from supplied bonus terms, without checking any offer, eligibility or ability to withdraw.

deposit.description: Non-negative deposit amount, in the same unit as the bonus.

bonus.description: Bonus amount or percentage of the deposit, according to bonusMode.

bonusMode.description: How the bonus input is expressed.

multiplier.description: Wagering multiplier from the terms, e.g. "20" for 20×.

basis.description: Which balance the wagering multiplier applies to.

contribution.description: Game contribution as percent text, e.g. "25" for 25%.
